title: Pathomics risk score links high-risk pancreatic cancer to B3GNT3 glycosylation
summary: H&E whole-slide images from TCGA-PAAD and Fujian Medical University Union Hospital were used to extract CellProfiler handcrafted features and ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50 deep features. LASSO with a random survival forest produced GlyPath-Risk from six pathological features, with C-indices of 0.88, 0.68 and 0.83 in the training, internal validation and hospital cohorts. Transcriptomic, single-cell, cell-communication and Geneformer virtual-perturbation analyses plus B3GNT3 knockdown experiments were used to generate and test hypotheses on a glycosylation program. Internal validation was only 0.68 and the knockdown work is only partly tied to the machine learning model.
ai_technology: LASSO and random survival forest on CellProfiler and ResNet-50 pathology features

evidence.tested: Evaluation in a hospital cohort (FMUUH) and B3GNT3 knockdown experiments.
evidence.unknown: Whether the glycosylation link is causal and prognostic value in other cohorts; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Builds the GlyPath-Risk prognostic score from slide features
